The plate is roughly 20 cm across in the photo (about 350 px wide, which fits a side plate). The scale is therefore about 0.057 cm per px.

There are 5 round items that look like meatballs. Each is about 50–60 px across, or about 3 cm. A sphere that size has a volume of about 14 cm³, which is roughly 15 g. The larger pieces may be closer to 18 g.

Total: 5 × ~15 g = ~75 g. They look like meatballs, so I used 230 kcal/100 g.
